name: Security lab
description: Look at traffic, programs and web apps you have the right to test.

apps.name: Wireshark
apps.why: Reads and takes apart packet captures made elsewhere.

apps.name: ZAP
apps.why: Tests a web application for flaws.

apps.name: Ghidra
apps.why: Takes a program apart to read what it does.

apps.name: Cutter
apps.why: Reverse engineering in a friendlier window.

apps.name: ImHex
apps.why: Reads and edits the bytes of a file.

apps.name: Boxes
apps.why: Runs a virtual machine to try things in.
